fullSourceProcedures.artisan: Choose one actual artisan-tool proficiency from the reviewed trade reference or another specifically profiled artisan tool; gain that proficiency. Initialize only its mapped trade at level1/zeroXP if previously untrained, retaining any existing greater level. NEW: “can create masterwork items” confirms access to that chosen tool’s legitimate Masterwork outcome when an otherwise authorized recipe/model qualifies; it is neither an automatic quality result nor access to every Masterwork-named recipe. Roll the existing quality procedure and satisfy trade level, formula, station, material and visibility gates. No generic creation bridge is granted by Artisan itself. Existing proficiency produces no automatic Expertise or free second choice; select an eligible unowned tool when available.
fullSourceProcedures.craftsman: Choose one actual artisan-tool proficiency and initialize only its mapped trade if needed. NEW: the time benefit applies to creation work that you personally lead and are otherwise eligible to perform, including non-artisan creation trades, not merely your selected tool. Use half the ordinary active manufacturing time with the shared strongest-discount rule; all required assistants attend that adjusted work. This creates no general proficiency in other trades. It covers a recipe’s active creation phases, including the mundane bridge where separately authorized. It does not reduce repair, harvesting, preservation, teaching, research, formula copying, ritual casting, training, services merely using a completed item, rest, or independently fixed incubation/calendar waits. Recalculate a new order’s full required time before setting its phases; do not retroactively claim unworked time on an old order. A feat acquired mid-order changes only its remaining unworked active creation requirement, with completed work retained and the change logged once.
fullSourceProcedures.versatile_artisan: Keep the printed requirement for an actual tool proficiency; owning tools is insufficient. NEW complete interpretation: select one of the16reviewed crafting disciplines for which you do not yet have its primary credential. Gain that exact primary-tool proficiency and initialize the discipline at level1/zeroXP. This is the feat’s cross-discipline training grant, not an ability to use one existing kit in every trade or import your highest trade level. Selection can include a non-artisan discipline because the source says discipline, not artisan-tool category. All formula/skill-level/station/material and protected-knowledge gates remain. If all16are already trained, this grant is exhausted; it supplies no Expertise, second specialization or additional trade level. An unrelated tool proficiency can satisfy the printed acquisition requirement but does not itself train a trade before this selection.
